steps.title: I arrive at the office.
steps.body: I walk in with my helper. It might be busy.

steps.title: I check in at the front desk.
steps.body: I say my name. They may ask for my card.

notice.text: a little nervous. That is okay.

steps.title: I wait in the waiting room.
steps.body: I sit and wait for my name. I can bring something I like.

steps.title: I sit in a special chair.
steps.body: The chair has a place for my arm. I can sit how I feel safe.

notice.text: My helper can stay with me.

steps.title: A band goes on my arm.
steps.body: It feels tight for a little while. They clean my arm. It feels cold and wet.

notice.text: I can ask what comes next.

steps.title: I feel a quick pinch.
steps.body: A small needle takes some blood. I can look away. I can ask them to count to three.

steps.title: I get a bandage. Then I'm done.
steps.body: They put a bandage on my arm. We say goodbye. I did it!

notice.text: I keep the bandage on for a while.
